description: Ms. Blackrose’s Stationary Store differentiates itself from the typical campus horror with mysterious and scary storyline. Extraordinary characteristic of Ms. Blackrose also adds interesting and peculiar atmosphere to this unique animation. Every episode portrays a story between a kid who tries to find Ms. Blackrose’s Stationary Store and Ms. Blackrose herself, based on motifs from Korean ghost stoies, Asian old legends and folktales and and classic gothic horror novels.
